correctness.rationale: Two changes are reflected in the complete affected files under /workspace/repairs/4/: the raw residual is 2C_n and converges to 2 times a Poisson variable, not itself to Poisson, and the finite enumerator is credited as a direct reweighting of an available component census rather than claimed as an independent new invariant. For fixed ranks k and l, row and column permutation symmetries give the probability (k)_r/(n)_r² of containing a specified ordered nonattacking r-list; independence gives the stated conditional moment of C_n and the falling-factorial expansion gives the polynomial. No exponent is actually negative, since r≤min(k,l). The mean follows from each cell having occupancy probability E[K_n]/n². Independently, deleting rows and columns of r specified shared cells gives the unnormalized polynomial sum over r of A_{n,r}(1-z²)^r times (sum_k A_{n-r,k}z^k)². /workspace/evidence/reproduce_other_checks.py verifies it by exact enumeration through n=4; a separate truncated expansion of the distance-marked component series also agreed through n=4. For the joint limit, the ordinary Laguerre Perron estimate at a=exp(u n^(-1/4)) gives the centered log-mgf u²/4+o(1) for each deficiency, thus both normalized ranks tend to one. The conditional characteristic function of C_n tends in probability and L¹ to exp(exp(iv)-1), since each fixed factorial ratio tends to one and the majorants |exp(iv)-1|^r/r! are summable. Multiplying by the two-deficiency characteristic factor proves the full joint product limit. Slutsky and rationalization yield the Gaussian squared- and ordinary-distance limits of variance 1 and 1/8 respectively. The residual has even support and limit 2Z independent of both Gaussian variables. The asymptotic arguments are not extrapolations from the finite tests.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The all-rank joint theorem needs a probabilistic transfer to ranks random on the n^(1/4) scale. One way to see this is to complete both partial permutations to independent uniform permutations and choose the removed row positions independently given the ranks: the probability of deleting a common full-permutation cell is at most (S_n+T_n)/n in conditional expectation. This illustrates the contribution as an explicit shared-cell limit and distance correction using classical ingredients, not a new proof of the permutation fixed-point law. No inspected prior theorem supplies this transfer for the stated observable.

value.rationale: The repaired claim separates fluctuating ranks from actual common-cell geometry in the standard metric on the square partial-matching polytope. Gaussian distance alone blends the two ranks and discards the overlap entirely; the additional independent unscaled limit determines overlap after subtracting measured ranks, including its exact lattice factor. This is a natural two-scale metric statistic of independent uniform vertices. Its value does not rest on reprioritizing the finite census or on novelty of the classical one-sample limits.
